comparison.objective: Seal a stationary, preloaded closed carton using tape from an ordinary loose roll; candidate rejects open cartons from a moving belt while passing closed cartons.
comparison.physical_skill: Tape-edge acquisition, payout, pressure bonding, end wrapping and cutting versus moving-target sidewall grasping, flap avoidance and spill-free transport.
comparison.success_condition: Requires measured seam coverage, two end wraps, severed tape and a 2 s released seal; candidate requires open-carton tray placement with contents retained and 3 s dwell, plus untouched closed-carton passage.
comparison.reason: Both involve cartons and flaps, but they test materially different abilities: adhesive tape application versus state-conditioned conveyor rejection. Draft lacks a finalized task.json and demonstrated full-task allowance, but its README/task.py/scoring.py versions clearly define a non-duplicate objective.
